name: This_5
short_caption: The robot extends its right arm outward and upward with an open palm to point out or present something.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture. It raises its right arm forward and outward, opening the hand with the palm facing up and slightly inward as if presenting an object or indicating a direction. After a short pause in this extended position, the robot smoothly lowers its right arm back down to its side, returning to the neutral resting pose.
safety_notes: The right arm extends forward and outward; ensure the front-right clearance zone is kept clear of close obstacles.
